## Checklist
- [ ] `rake` passes (full lint + test)
- [ ] Claims verified by running it, not asserted from memory
- [ ] Repro or PoC included if this is a bug fix
- [ ] Security and performance considered if it touches credentials, network, or hot paths
- [ ] New dependency? Declared its real minimum version in the gemspec
- [ ] AI-assisted is fine; you own it (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
